name: socialbattery-mobile
description: SocialBattery mobile wrapper (Android + iOS via Capacitor)
author: SocialBattery

scripts.add:android: npm run check-url && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.add:ios: npm run check-url && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:android: npm run check-url && npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run check-url && npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
